slowest_experiments.experiment: Selective priority arbiter versus flat retry A/B
V595 evidence synthesis and branch disposition

summary: Five experiments finished in 15.9 minutes. The only compute-bound experiment occupied 15.9 minutes, and the locked compute-task GPU-idle indicator is false.
bottlenecks_identified: Three-model operational-handoff proposal corpus v2 was the only compute-bound experiment and occupied 15.9 minutes, equal to the full reconstructed milestone window.
Disk-mtime reconstruction has no task-phase timing, so no data available this milestone explains the compute-bound experiment's duration.
improvements_suggested: Record monotonic task and phase timestamps so the next retrospective can locate the slow phase without disk-mtime inference.
Attach GPU samples, loaded-model count, and runner identity to each compute-task launch receipt.
Add readiness-aware accelerator placement that sends a second eligible model workload to GPU 0; use DualGPURunner only when 2 or more models are loaded in parallel.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add task-owned monotonic phase timing for compute launches.
Emit a launch receipt with task-linked GPU activity, loaded-model count, and runner identity.
Dispatch a second eligible model workload to the unused GPU, with DualGPURunner gated on actual parallel model loading.
meta_reflection: The bounded data establishes critical-path concentration and active compute use, but it does not establish the slow phase or parallel-runner eligibility. The recommendations therefore improve attribution and conditional device placement without claiming a measured speedup.
